Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You stretch a hand toward the prize; your shadow’s fingers arrive before yours.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One visible unattended object of Bulk 0 or 1 within 6 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Utility

Reach with your shadow along an open path; you cannot take held or worn equipment. Use ordinary terrain costs and move the object toward yourself.

Weak
Move it up to 2 squares.
Standard
Move it up to 4 squares.
Strong
Move it up to 6 squares.

If it reaches you, catch it in a free hand. Otherwise leave it in the last square reached. This causes no impact damage.
